Parse age-group labels

Source: R/data-axis.R
parse_age_labels.Rd

Understands the label styles of common sources, for example "<1", "Under 1", "01-14", "1 to 4", "30-34", "30-34 years", "1 and under 5", "90+", "85 and over", "85 years and older", "90 & over", "Age 85+", "0", "110+", and the German labels of the Federal Statistical Office ("unter 1 Jahr", "15 bis unter 20 Jahre", "1 bis 4 Jahre", "85 Jahre und mehr", and single years written as "68-Jaehrige" with an umlaut).

Usage

parse_age_labels(x)

Arguments

x

Character vector of labels.

Value

A data.table with label, age_lo, age_hi (Inf for open intervals), in the order of x.

Examples

parse_age_labels(c("<1", "01-14", "15-19", "90+"))
#>     label age_lo age_hi
#>    <char>  <num>  <num>
#> 1:     <1      0      1
#> 2:  01-14      1     15
#> 3:  15-19     15     20
#> 4:    90+     90    Inf
parse_age_labels(c("Under 1", "1 to 4", "85 years and over"))
#>                label age_lo age_hi
#>               <char>  <num>  <num>
#> 1:           Under 1      0      1
#> 2:            1 to 4      1      5
#> 3: 85 years and over     85    Inf
